summary: Iteration 2 (new features) — Backend: 15/15 pytest green (prev 11 + 4 new for SSE stream & documents). Frontend: GhostLogs SSE EventSource verified live on proj-atlas (6 streamed lines including 'ghostcli run --project proj-atlas --step 04' and 'Sincron Brain MCP'); step advanced after stream. Kanban columns render correctly (atlas: 8 aguardando / 2 bloqueado / 1 active / 3 done = 14 total; active card has draggable=true). Roadmap renders 16 rows for proj-meridian with amber diamond markers on Gate steps. Documents tab lists 4 files (PROJECT.md, 01-briefing-gate0.md, 02-requisitos.md, 03-arquitetura.md), each with 'Banca Revisora Independente' seal; switching docs changes rendered markdown. All 7 tabs switch correctly; regression on Pendencies/Gate0 unaffected. Note: HTML5 drag-and-drop could not be reliably simulated via synthetic DragEvent+DataTransfer in headless harness (card returned to active column); the columns and draggable attribute are correct, and backend complete-step path is already covered by pytest.

minor.issue: Still from iter 1 — guard.passed=5/8 for the 6-step completed SY-M project (rules 5-7 hard-coded to done>=8/10/12). Not re-tested in this iteration; main agent action item carries over.

action_items: (Carry-over) Fix completion_guard() rule thresholds so proj-crm concluido returns 8/8 (scale by ratio or short-circuit when status=='concluido').
Optional: use Playwright's native page.drag_and_drop or mouse.down/move/up to make kanban HTML5 drag-drop e2e-testable (current native drag works in real browser but not through dispatchEvent).
critical_code_review_comments: GhostLogs panel is position:fixed bottom-right with w-[min(540px,calc(100vw-360px))]; on narrow viewports it overlaps the Pendencies card bottom-right area (seen in Overview screenshot). Consider offsetting content with bottom padding or z-index guard.

ProjectView.streamStep() uses EventSource with no abort on component unmount — if user navigates away mid-stream the ES stays open until 'end'. Minor leak; wrap in a ref and close in useEffect cleanup.

KanbanBoard.drop() only reads dragId state; works for same-session drag but ignores dataTransfer, so cross-window DnD and some test harnesses cannot drive it. Consider setting dataTransfer.setData in onDragStart.
GET /api/projects/{pid}/stream/{step_idx} does not validate step_idx numeric range (returns 'etapa não encontrada' line but still 200/stream). Low risk.
RoadmapGantt phase coloring uses `Math.floor(i / Math.ceil(total/4))` which can give index 4 (out of 0..3) for last row when total is not divisible by 4; works due to %4 but logic is subtle.
md.jsx renderer trust level unknown — ensure documents (user-controlled brief fields will flow into briefing_md) are sanitized before rendering as HTML to avoid XSS from Gate 0 form.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical new-feature flows verified; kanban drag completion via synthetic events not simulable (columns/draggable correct)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/admin/reseed before each counting UI check.
